title: oligoneuron × bernardii
intro: Oligoneuron × bernardii, commonly known as Bernard's Goldenrod, is a hybrid plant species in the sunflower family. It is used in herbal medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are beneficial for various health issues. The health benefits of Oligoneuron × bernardii include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and fighting off infections, while its therapeutic actions include soothing skin irritations and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
